title: Amazingly Aromatic Mexican Poblanos Quesadilla
description: A fresh and snappy Mexican dish featuring roasted poblanos, dried cherries, and melted cheese, all wrapped in a crispy clay-pot-cooked quesadilla. This kosher-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the clay pot over medium heat.
Roast the poblano peppers in the oven at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.
Peel the roasted poblanos and chop them into small pieces.
Heat the olive oil in the clay pot and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the chopped poblanos, dried cherries, salt, and pepper to the clay pot and stir to combine.
In a separate pan, warm the tortillas over medium heat for 1 minute on each side.
Assemble the quesadillas by placing a tortilla in the clay pot, topping with the poblano mixture and shredded cheese, and folding the tortilla in half.
Cook the quesadillas for 2 minutes on each side, until crispy and melted.
Serve the quesadillas hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
